text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Buena-san, how was the birthday bento? I 
put way more effort into it than usual, 
but did it fill you up!?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Ahh, my tummy's full, and I'm 
just so happy...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
A big, round onigiri. Along with a tiered 
box packed with side dishes— which was 
handed to me first thing in the morning.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"You prepared this for me while it was 
still dark out, didn't you? During that 
quiet time before anyone else was 
awake..."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Because... it must have been so much work 
for you, Senior... Waking up early... and 
preparing all of this, each and every 
item, all by yourself...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it was nothing at all once I thought 
about how happy it'd make you, Buena-san!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Helping out people around the academy 
from early in the morning, and then 
heading out for a run right after that.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I was watching, you know~? So here's 
a cheer-you-on bento!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
So that the hardworking, straightforward 
Buena-san can always stay true to herself! 
...May I keep cheering you on from now on 
too?
